title: Measure the work, not the people
sub: Film 2 of Ownership and performance, in Leading data people: measures are for learning how the work flows, read together by the team, to find what in the system to fix. Pair each measure with one that balances it, and never rank people by them.
howto: The film is drawn in ink line: flat colour with one even dark line, and whole people in the places where they work and meet, in Sweden from 1997 and at the university. Its ideas are written by hand: at a board, where a consultant and Helena explain them to the team, and in Helena's notebook, where she keeps what to remember. Its colours mean the same in every film: orange is data (the crashes on the map, the team's numbers), amber a wait or a cost (the wait for access, work over the limit), green something done or better (the roads with a barrier, the numbers that improved), and blue a plan or a rule (Vision Zero, the team's limit, Helena's answer). People and their clothes wear none of them.
